notes.title: Book of Beasts starts 2021: leaderboards, avatars, world map
notes.content:
Greetings summoners! We are excited to share what we are working on for our next releases of Book of Beasts. During the last weeks we have carefully collected your valuable feedback and have worked on concepts for the next features in Book of Beasts, which we will release over the course of the upcoming months of 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/b311d619bc8781a9129c9913a2428bf1d898d78b.png[/img]

[h2]Avatars[/h2]

As a first step in customising your player experience you will be able to choose from a first set of summoner portraits that will become your avatar in battle. Of course this is just the beginning and we will add more summoners along our journey together. Introducing more characters will allow us to tell more about the world of Book of Beasts and its stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/da63ec23447c774e049a110dade99fb77991f341.png[/img]

[h2]World Map[/h2]

Talking about the world of Book of Beasts: we’re especially excited to start uncovering the land in which Book of Beasts takes place. In the game, it will be possible to battle new AI summoners and unlock them so you can choose their portrait as your own avatar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/2d491b563a4804b016458f14a28ce4fd5d23fe43.png[/img]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]

A leaderboard to compare your experience with other summoners has been an early request. While we are collecting all wins in the background already, we have been working on a concept to show how you are doing in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/220e9dfef6d9494fff0cbae909cccd94c3a096a2.png[/img]

And of course we are working on many more improvements to make Book of Beasts a delight! [url=https://discord.com/invite/FqH7w28]Let us know on our Discord channel[/url] if you want to share your experience and discuss these and other features with us!

See you in the arena, summoners!

… and before we forget: here is a code to get a Spell Card: [i]deepdive[/i]

notes.title: Season's greetings, we have a gift (code) for you, summoners!
notes.content:
Thank you for being a part of the Book of Beasts game! We hope you’re also ready to give this year a proper send-off. As a small gift for the holiday season celebration, we have updated the game Book of Beasts for all platforms and have scattered around the Internet some codes that you can find and exchange in the game for great Spell Cards. One code is right here: mirrormirror. You might find other codes on our website, our social media outlets, the Discord community and elsewhere. Maybe some other games mention it on their social media channels with hashtag #BookOfBeastsGame. Further features in this update include:

[list]
[*]A season’s Book of Beasts awaits you in the main menu screen.
[*]Added the ability to enter codes to redeem free items (go check the lovely new treasure chest in the shop view).
[*]Added German as language.
[*]You get notified about lobby activity in AI matches.
[*]We have laid the groundwork for a next update for the beginning of next year.
[*]Bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Book of Beasts and see you in the arena!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/6878ecdd119ca73177781b4489887f08d87151bd.png[/img]

notes.title: 🔴👹 Deck Building Workshop LIVE
notes.content:
We're participating in the #DigitalTabletopFest. Book of Beasts, our forthcoming collectible card game, fuses board games with collectible card games and offers swift battles at its core. It's approachable for a wide audience, and then still hard to master if you want to really master the meta game and to shine at deck building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/e50642033123cb74e867f90e3ff33ed6cb215672.gif[/img]

[h1]Different sophisticated decks[/h1]

Game designer Andi and e-sports pro Eduism discuss different card decks that the community and our game design wizards have put together. It's valuable that you listen to their experienced advice.

[h1]Play-test decks against e-sports professional Eduism[/h1]

Then, we'll try out the decks in online games with the players that already have the time-limted demo installed.

[h1]How was is inspired by tabletop games?[/h1]

“Book of Beasts” brings together the best of both worlds – of board games and collectible card games. In the game, collected cards become tiles on a shared battlefield so every card can be turned against you. This unique twist makes heavy use of the tabletop space on which visually striking Beast Cards are placed by connecting gems. Spell Cards modify game rules during battles and offer a strategic and tactical spin to more advanced players. Beast Cards and Spell Cards can be used in deck building to craft winning decks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/3835f7a1d93bace00c8f77c3295de65cc1fe8abf.gif[/img]

#DigitalTabletopFest

notes.title: 👹 🔴 Beat the Devs — exclusive live demo with "Book of Beasts"
notes.content:
Get the demo for a limited time during the festival only [b]and challenge us, the makers of the game[/b]. All participants will win a in-game badge that you can show off once the game is released later this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38830435/3835f7a1d93bace00c8f77c3295de65cc1fe8abf.gif[/img]

We are going to show off Book of Beasts, the soon to be released collectible card game (CCG) where you place cards on the board by smartly connecting Gems on Beast Cards. Every card on the shared battlefield can be used against you. Additional Spell Cards and deck building offer unlimited strategies and endless battle challenges!

[quote=PocketGamer] “...SET TO BE ONE OF THE NEXT BIG SUCCESS STORIES” — PocketGamer[/quote]

💎 PRE-REGISTER NOW! 💎
Play the next free-to-play card game hit when it’s available!

💎 COMING NOVEMBER 18 2020! 💎

👹 OVER 60 CARDS ON LAUNCH DAY 👹

✨ ONLINE BATTLES ✨
Battle players all around the globe.

🌱 SUMMON BEASTS 🌱
Collect cards of mythical beasts.

🔥 CAST SPELLS 🔥
Use Spell Cards to win the battle.

💨 BUILD DECKS 💨
The best card decks win.

[h1]CARD TYPES:[/h1]

[list]
[*] BEAST CARDS: Connect the five Gems representing Fire 🔥, Water 💧, Air 💨, Earth 🌱 and Spirit ✨
[*] TURN SPELL CARDS: Impact your turn. ⚡
[*] BATTLE SPELLS CARDS: Change the battle to your favour 🌪️
[/list]

[h1]💧 HOW TO PLAY 💧[/h1]

[list]
[*] Score by connecting Beast Cards with matching Gems
[*] All your cards played in a turn must be placed next to each other.
[*] Gems can only be connected to the same Gem or blank edges.
[/list]

[h1]💯 SCORING 💯[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]MANA POINTS[/b]: Each new Gem connection awards points according to the lower of the two Gems values.
[*] [b]TRINITY BONUS[/b]: If at least 3 different Gems are connected in a turn, the player gets 2 Mana Points.
[*] [b]MANA POOL[/b]: If all Gems on a card with a Mana Pool are connected, the player gets the score indicated on the Mana Pool.
[*] [b]END OF GAME[/b]: If it’s a player’s turn and they have no more cards in their hand and deck, the game ends.
[*] The player with most Mana Points wins.
[/list]

[h1]ːsteamsaltyː PRO TIPS ːsteamsaltyː[/h1]

[h2]DECK BUILDING[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Build decks in your card collection and play with [b]your own creations[/b]. You are only permitted a maximum of 2 of each card in your deck. Find out how you can make your deck even better with new cards.
[*] [b]Each type of Gem[/b] (Fire, Water, Air, Earth and Spirit) has different advantages. Combine them with matching Turn Spells and Battle Spells for maximum points.
[*] [b]Balance[/b]: The relationship between Beast Cards and Spell Cards is crucial to your strategy. Experiment and find the right balance for your strategy.
[/olist]

[h2]STRATEGIES[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]BLOCKING[/b]: Block your opponents from forming combinations by using the blank edges on your Beast Cards. This prevents your opponents from making high-scoring Beast Card connections.
[*] [b]MANA POOLS[/b]: Mana Pools can be unlocked when they are placed smartly. But be careful – your opponent can also unlock them!
[*] [b]OPPONENT’S HAND[/b]: Become a true Book of Beasts master by analysing and taking into account the opponent’s cards in your own turn.
[/olist]
